name: companion-drones-mjlfix-tfp
title: Companion Drones for 2.0_FIXTFP
author: loltorres9 (TFP fixes); Maoman, MrJakobLaich, kubiixx, Klonan (original)
description: Fork of "Companion Drones for 2.0" (companion-drones-mjlfix) by Maoman, with two bugfixes: drones no longer get stuck on unbuildable ghosts (e.g. on water) and no longer fly extremely far away from the player (jobs limited to 48 tiles). Prototype names are unchanged; disable the original mod before using this one. Credits: Klonan (original Companion Drones), kubiixx, MrJakobLaich, Maoman.
